A COMBINATORIAL DESCRIPTION OF
THE DORMANT MIURA TRANSFORMATION
YASUHIRO WAKABAYASHI
Abstract. A dormant generic Miura sl2-oper is a ﬂat PGL2-bundle over an algebraic curve
in positive characteristic equipped with some additional data. In the present paper, we give
a combinatorial description of dormant generic Miura sl2-opers on a totally degenerate curve.
The combinatorial objects that we use are certain branch numberings of 3-regular graphs.
Our description may be thought of as an analogue of the combinatorial description of dormant
sl2-opers given by S. Mochizuki, F. Liu, and B. Osserman. It allows us to think of the Miura
transformation in terms of combinatorics. As an application, we identify the dormant generic
Miura sl2-opers on totally degenerate curves of genus > 0.

Abstract: A dormant generic Miura sl2-oper is a ﬂat PGL2-bundle over an algebraic curve in positive characteristic equipped with some additional data. In the present paper, we give a combinatorial description of dormant generic Miura sl2-opers on a totally degenerate curve. The combinatorial objects that we use are certain branch numberings of 3-regular graphs. Our description may be thought of as an analogue of the combinatorial description of dormant sl2-opers given by S. Mochizuki, F. Liu, and B. Osserman. It allows us to think of the Miura transformation in terms of combinatorics. As an application, we identify the dormant generic Miura sl2-opers on totally degenerate curves of genus > 0. Contents
